channel.title: Google Antigravity — Changelog
channel.description: Release notes and changelog for Google Antigravity, minted by feedmint.

item.title: CLI 1.5.4: Auto mode for ACP sessions, enriched hook JSON input, faster sandbox reviews, and stability fixes
item.description: Antigravity CLI 1.5.4 introduces Auto mode support for ACP editor sessions, expands hook JSON payloads with event metadata, speeds up Auto mode command reviews, and resolves stability issues across subagents, conversation paging, and authentication.

item.title: CLI 1.5.5: Added agent swarms preview,/swarm board, Gemini 4 Carbon support, and plugin import fixes.
item.description: Antigravity CLI 1.5.5 introduces a preview of agent swarms with/swarmand/swarm board, adds Gemini 4 Carbon models when using Application Default Credentials, enforces HTTPS for remote enterprise model gateways, and resolves issues with plugin imports, subagent worktrees, and headless run shutdowns.

item.title: Model launch: Gemini 4 Carbon
item.description: Gemini 4 Carbon is our strongest model for long-horizon software engineering, knowledge work, scientific discovery, and cybersecurity.

item.title: Hub 2.30.0: Knowledge Work interface and a setup tailored to your work
item.description: This release adds a Knowledge Work layout with a simpler interface for research, writing, and everyday tasks. When you first sign in, Antigravity now asks what kind of work you do and suggests ways to start. Voice mode and remote agents have also finished rolling out. It includes 27 improvements and 25 fixes.

item.title: Hub 2.31.0: /swarm, Font size setting, split-view plugins, and browser download approvals
item.description: This release adds a font size setting, lets you open plugin views next to a conversation in split view, and asks for your approval before the browser agent downloads a file. It also brings call summaries to voice mode and Google Cloud project autocomplete to Pay-As-You-Go setup. It includes 10 improvements and 18 fixes.

item.title: CLI 1.5.3: Subagent model display, plugin hook env vars, non-UTF-8 file handling, and terminal security
item.description: This release displays each subagent's model in the UI and status line JSON, adds PLUGIN_ROOT and PLUGIN_DATA environment variables to plugin hooks, and resolves bugs related to symlinked plugins, non-UTF-8 file encodings, and terminal sandbox security.

item.title: Hub 2.29.1: Voice mode fixes for sign-in, links, and transcripts
item.description: This release fixes several voice mode issues. Voice mode now asks you to sign in again when your sign-in needs an update, and it sees the links and @ mentions in messages you type.

item.title: CLI 1.5.2: Cloud plugin skills in remote sessions, native macOS Option shortcuts, and security hardening.
item.description: Antigravity CLI 1.5.2 brings cloud plugin skills to remote agent sessions, enables macOS Option-key shortcuts out of the box, tightens permission and plugin security boundaries, and resolves several issues with MCP OAuth, subagent permissions, and remote file uploads.

item.title: CLI 1.5.1: Broader ACP model access, faster terminal exits, sandbox OAuth hardening, and Windows fixes.
item.description: Antigravity CLI 1.5.1 expands model availability across all ACP clients, speeds up terminal command completion when background processes stay open, hardens plugin OAuth token protection in the sandbox, and resolves several ACP session, Windows encoding/CRLF, and plugin authentication bugs.

item.title: CLI 1.5.0: Added ACP server mode, remote agent sessions, local project management, and MCP plugin sign-in
item.description: Antigravity CLI 1.5.0 introducesagy acpto run as an Agent Client Protocol server for editors,--remote-agentfor running conversations on remote agents, and local project management in/projects. This release also adds sign-in flows for partner plugin MCP servers, supports tool calls in/btwside questions, improves headless background task handling, and fixes several UI, API retry, and plugin upgrade issues.

item.title: Hub 2.29.0: Voice mode, remote agents, redesigned Automations, and Jupyter notebook viewer
item.description: Voice mode, enabled by Gemini Live, and remote agents, which run conversations in the cloud, are starting to roll out. This release also adds redesigned Home and Automations pages, a native Jupyter notebook viewer, and downloads and browsing history in the built-in browser.

item.title: Visual Studio 1.0.261102.0: Inline diffs enabled by default with syntax highlighting, Tools Options configuration, review card diffs, Help menu feedback
item.description: Introduces in-editor inline diffs enabled by default with syntax-highlighted deletion blocks, read-only side-by-side diff views from conversation review cards, and aHelp > Antigravity: Provide Feedbackcommand in Visual Studio.

item.title: VS Code 1.11.0: Clickable terminal context pills, status bar and editor menus, scoped diff review commands, and multi-window sign-in sync
item.description: Introduces clickable terminal context pills with snippet previews and dedicated terminal shortcuts, adds quick-access status bar, editor context, and view title menus, disambiguates diff accept and reject commands by scope, and delivers faster Cloud Workstation startup alongside multi-turn diff review, Auto Save, and multi-window authentication fixes.

item.title: CLI 1.4.11: Google Cloud billing model selection, PreInvocation hook termination, JSON finished_reason reporting, and Claude plugin MCP import fixes
item.description: Adds Google Cloud sign-in billing model selection (Gemini subscription or Pay As You Go), PreInvocation hook turn termination and custom error messages, a finished_reason field in JSON output modes, collapsible shelves in the /plugin Discover tab, and expanded Claude Code marketplace plugin and remote MCP server import.

item.title: CLI 1.4.12: Optional plugin API key providers and streaming Markdown table scrollback alignment
item.description: Adds optional API key support in plugin auth.json configurations for services with unauthenticated free tiers, and keeps streaming Markdown tables in the live view until complete so terminal scrollback renders with aligned column widths.

item.title: CLI 1.4.10: Low-bandwidth terminal scrollback streaming, post-startup memory reclamation, accurate compaction size metrics, and automatic image resizing
item.description: Reduces terminal streaming output by ~70% using native scrollback and batched text wrapping, reclaims ~100 MB of startup memory after launch, reports full post-compaction context size in /context, and automatically resizes large attached images to prevent request size errors.

item.title: Hub 2.28.2: Partner plugins in the Marketplace and plugin sign-in
item.description: This release brings plugins from partners such as Figma, Linear, Notion, and Stripe to the Marketplace, with a new Featured spotlight. You can also sign in to a plugin's account right after you add it.

item.title: CLI 1.4.9: Native terminal image paste and drag-and-drop, categorized marketplace shelves in /plugin, and per-origin Google app URL permissions
item.description: Adds native terminal shortcut and drag-and-drop image attachment (including over SSH with X11 or Wayland forwarding), organizes the /plugin Discover tab into marketplace shelves, validates plugin names and logos in agy plugin validate, and separates execute_url approvals for sensitive Google apps.

item.title: Hub 2.28.1: Conversation navigator and third party tools notice
item.description: This release adds a conversation navigator, so you can jump to any turn in a long conversation. The Marketplace now also shows a notice about third party developer tools.

item.title: Eclipse 1.0.0: Initial release of Antigravity for Eclipse with agentic chat, side-by-side diff review, artifact previews, workspace trust, and theme synchronization.
item.description: Introduces Antigravity for Eclipse with an embedded agentic chat view, side-by-side compare editor diffs, interactive artifact previews, smart project import suggestions, workspace trust controls, and automatic Eclipse theme synchronization.

item.title: CLI 1.4.8: Turn navigation shortcuts and progressive loading in /diff, longer Auto mode review timeouts, and detailed plugin install summaries
item.description: Adds [ and ] turn-jump shortcuts and progressive background loading to /diff, extends Auto mode sandbox review timeouts, and expands agy plugin install and validate output, alongside fixes for failed tool call error reporting, forked /goal cancellation, and Windows clipboard image paste.

item.title: Hub 2.28.0: Built-in browser and attachments of any file type
item.description: This release adds a built-in browser that opens web pages in the side panel, a built-in PDF viewer, attachments of any file type, and word and character highlighting in diffs. It also adds a shortcut to reopen closed side panel tabs. It includes 19 improvements and 14 fixes.

item.title: IDE 2.6.0: Gemini 4 Argon, Refreshed Agent Interface, and Inline Diff Shortcuts
item.description: Gemini 4 Argon is now available in the IDE, alongside a refreshed agent interface and architecture, keyboard shortcuts for inline diffs, inline editor comments, and faster multi-window startup.

item.title: SDK 0.1.23: Programmatic workflow tool calls, multi-turn workflow agents, LiteRT conversation caching, and custom system instruction titles
item.description: Google Antigravity Python SDK v0.1.23 expands dynamic workflow orchestration with programmatic tool execution, reusable multi-turn workflow agents, and structured workflow input arguments, while adding multi-turn conversation caching for local LiteRT models and custom section titles for replacement system instructions. This release also improves OpenAPI/JSON Schema metadata preservation, deterministic tool path normalization, media home-directory expansion, and workflow JSON-RPC stream resilience.

item.title: Visual Studio 1.0.261026.0: Terminal and Output window context (@terminal), Send to Terminal chat action, VSIX changelog, and unified telemetry settings
item.description: Introduces@terminalcontext mentions and context-menu actions for Visual Studio's integrated terminal andOutputwindow, adds aSend to Terminalaction in chat, bundles the extension changelog with aHelp > Antigravity Changelogcommand, and unifies telemetry settings alongside initialization, diff tracking, and feedback reporting fixes.

item.title: VS Code 1.10.0: Agent editor comments, status bar sign-in indicator and Sign Out command, automatic backend recovery, and sidecar startup caching
item.description: Introduces inline editor and diff commenting to queue feedback for the agent, adds a live status bar sign-in indicator and Command Palette sign-out action, enables automatic background server recovery and webview reconnection by default, and improves startup performance with sidecar version caching and cross-window install locking alongside port fallback, CPU diagnostic, and VS Code Web origin fixes.

item.title: Hub 2.27.0: Markdown previews and overview sections in new side panel tabs
item.description: This release shows Markdown code blocks as a rendered preview with a Raw toggle and fills a new side panel tab with the conversation's overview sections. It includes 5 improvements and 14 fixes.

item.title: CLI 1.4.7: Hook stdin lastUserInput field, seasonal Halloween theme, 10 KB on-demand MCP tool outputs, and ADC customization loading fix
item.description: Passes lastUserInput to hook stdin payloads, adds an opt-in seasonal Halloween theme in /config, increases on-demand MCP tool inline output limits to 10 KB, and reduces headless -p CPU overhead, alongside fixes for ADC customization loading and per-user MCP OAuth token isolation.

item.title: CLI 1.4.6: Plugin MCP server configuration UI, stronger sandbox credential protections, word-level /diff highlights, and subagent permission inheritance
item.description: Adds a Configure MCP servers action for installed plugins in /plugin, restricts sandbox access to ~/.docker, ~/.kube, and ~/_netrc credentials by default, preserves attached media across compaction summaries, and highlights word-level edits in /diff.

item.title: CLI 1.4.5: Streamlined collapsed thought blocks, folded-line match counts in /diff search, jittered cron schedules, and lower idle CPU usage
item.description: Refines collapsed thought blocks in agent responses, counts hidden matches inside folded lines during /diff search, adds per-schedule jitter offsets to recurring cron schedules, and cuts idle and streaming CPU usage, alongside fixes for content safety retry loops and marketplace plugin download retries.

item.title: Hub 2.26.0: Notifications settings, docked question prompts, and conversation palette filters
item.description: This release adds a Notifications page in Settings with sound and volume controls, docks question and permission prompts above the message box so you can keep typing, and adds sort and filter options to the conversations palette. It includes 8 improvements and 15 fixes.

item.title: CLI 1.4.4: Windows 11 Auto mode, /diff whole-file toggle and hunk folding, and streaming performance optimizations
item.description: Adds Auto mode on Windows 11 24H2+, whole-file toggle and hunk folding in /diff with combined per-turn file diffs, root conversation ID metadata on MCP tool calls, and streaming CPU/memory optimizations, alongside fixes for subagent plugin inheritance, Remote Control tablet layouts, and prompt undo behavior.

item.title: CLI 1.4.3: Interactive /diff search, hook and sidecar plugin validation, and CJK/emoji cursor handling fixes
item.description: Adds live / search across the /diff file list and file view, expands agy plugin validate to inspect hooks, sidecars, and component manifests, formats task timer durations in human-readable units, and resolves multiple subagent, Windows plugin update, and CJK/emoji cursor positioning issues.

item.title: Hub 2.25.0: Plugin sidebar badges, window shortcuts, and reliability fixes
item.description: This release shows plugin badges on managed projects in the sidebar, hides empty plugin projects, and improves window shortcuts. It includes 3 improvements and 8 fixes.

item.title: VS Code 1.9.0: Inline diff hunk keyboard shortcuts, unified telemetry settings, Cloud Workstations ambient authentication, and server auto-recovery
item.description: Introduces keyboard shortcuts for accepting or rejecting focused inline diff hunks, unifies telemetry controls in Account settings, adds seamless ambient authentication in Google Cloud Workstations and Google Cloud Shell, and enables opt-in automatic language server crash recovery and liveness probing alongside inline diff and chat reconnection fixes.

item.title: CLI 1.4.2: Remote Control daemon mode conversation history fix
item.description: Fixes an issue where conversation history did not appear in Remote Control when running in daemon mode.

item.title: CLI 1.4.1: Plugin validation for skills, subagents, and rules, syntax-highlighted inline diff previews, and prompt rendering optimizations
item.description: Expands agy plugin validate to check skills, subagents, and rules, adds syntax highlighting and background tints to inline diff previews, reduces CPU usage during prompt rendering, and fixes Business account telemetry settings, Windows sandbox fallback, and network socket retry handling.

item.title: Xcode 1.4.1: Grouped Claude thinking-level variants, Android Studio third-party model support, and model availability filtering fixes
item.description: Groups multi-effort Claude model variants under thethinking_levelselector, enables third-party models in Android Studio, and fixes model tier filtering and custom LLM gateway header merging.

item.title: Zed 1.4.1: Grouped Claude thinking-level variants, Android Studio third-party model support, and model availability filtering fixes
item.description: Groups multi-effort Claude model variants under thethinking_levelselector, enables third-party models in Android Studio, and fixes model tier filtering and custom LLM gateway header merging.

item.title: JetBrains 1.4.1: Grouped Claude thinking-level variants, Android Studio third-party model support, and model availability filtering fixes
item.description: Groups multi-effort Claude model variants under thethinking_levelselector, enables third-party models in Android Studio, and fixes model tier filtering and custom LLM gateway header merging.

item.title: Visual Studio 1.0.261016.0: Fixes an issue where the Antigravity chat panel could hang in a Working... state when sending a prompt
item.description: Fixes an issue where the Antigravity chat panel could hang indefinitely in a "Working..." state when sending a prompt.

item.title: CLI 1.4.0: OSC 7501 terminal status reporting, alt+m message queue toggle, and enhanced agy plugin validate diagnostics
item.description: Adds terminal status reporting over OSC 7501, the alt+m shortcut to toggle between immediate and queued message delivery, and comprehensive plugin validation rules in agy plugin validate with --strict and --json flags, alongside fixes for startup eligibility checks, MCP header variable expansion, and 100-commit history in /diff.

item.title: CLI 1.3.6: Claude 5.5 models via ADC, enhanced Auto mode sandbox reviews, colorized Commit Tree in /diff, and model stall recovery
item.description: Adds support for Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5.5 via Application Default Credentials, enhances Auto mode sandbox egress reviews, colorizes the /diff Commit Tree view, and introduces automatic cancellation and retry for stalled model connections.

item.title: Hub 2.24.0: Redesigned side panel, /compact, and model choice for automations
item.description: Launch the updated side panel from the overview button during an active conversation, use /compact command for long conversations, and you can now choose a specific model for your automations.

item.title: CLI 1.3.5: Auto mode for autonomous command approvals, on-demand /compact conversation summarization, and syntax highlighting with folding in /diff
item.description: Introduces Auto mode to approve safe file edits and commands autonomously with secondary agent verification for sandbox escapes, adds the /compact slash command for on-demand context reduction, and delivers syntax highlighting, code folding, and virtualization to the /diff file viewer.

item.title: CLI 1.3.4: JSON output for plugin listing, default thinking level selection, and browser settings synchronization for Remote Control
item.description: Adds a --json flag to plugin listings, allows selecting base models without an explicit thinking effort, improves Remote Control settings synchronization between CLI and browser, and fixes retry backoffs, OAuth session persistence for remote MCP servers, and colored repository diffs.

item.title: Hub 2.23.1: Fix for the license picker during sign-in
item.description: This release fixes the license picker shown during onboarding, which could grow taller than the window and hide the buttons below it.

item.title: Model launch: Gemini 4 Argon
item.description: Gemini 4 Argon is built for the most complex software engineering and knowledge work.

item.title: SDK 0.1.22: Dynamic workflow orchestration, in-memory skill definitions, and configurable per-step output token limits
item.description: Google Antigravity Python SDK v0.1.22 introduces beta support for dynamic workflow orchestration, in-memory skill definitions, and configurable per-step output token limits for extended model decodes. This release also standardizes subagent invocation naming onBuiltinTools.INVOKE_SUBAGENTand provides fine-grained controls over MCP tool payload limits and eager tool registration.

item.title: Xcode 1.4.0: Interactive /usage command, dedicated thinking-level picker, eager MCP tool loading, and custom system instructions
item.description: Introduces the/usagetoken and quota command, a dedicatedthinking_levelsession config picker, dynamic enterprise LLM gateway model discovery, eager MCP tool loading, and custom system prompt instructions.

item.title: Zed 1.4.0: Interactive /usage command, dedicated thinking-level picker, eager MCP tool loading, and custom system instructions
item.description: Introduces the/usagetoken and quota command, a dedicatedthinking_levelsession config picker, dynamic enterprise LLM gateway model discovery, eager MCP tool loading, and custom system prompt instructions.

item.title: JetBrains 1.4.0: Interactive /usage command, dedicated thinking-level picker, eager MCP tool loading, and custom system instructions
item.description: Introduces the/usagetoken and quota command, a dedicatedthinking_levelsession config picker, dynamic enterprise LLM gateway model discovery, eager MCP tool loading, and custom system prompt instructions.

item.title: Visual Studio 1.0.261012.0: Fixes for conversation history persistence across Visual Studio restarts, chat input focus after agent file edits, and multi-turn diff review handling
item.description: Fixes conversation restoration across Visual Studio restarts, resolves a chat input focus bug after agent file edits, and improves multi-turn diff review handling.

item.title: VS Code 1.8.0: Cumulative multi-turn inline diff reviews, automatic external disk-change detection, and reliability fixes for inline diff restoration and startup
item.description: Introduces cumulative multi-turn inline diff reviews and automatic disk-change detection, while improving inline diff restoration across window reloads and conversation rollbacks.

item.title: Hub 2.23.0: Permissions picker, full-screen media viewer, and .zip attachments
item.description: This release adds a permissions picker to the message box, opens images and videos in a full-screen viewer, and lets you attach .zip archives and folders. Onboarding now shows what Antigravity can do instead of asking you to pick a theme.

item.title: CLI 1.3.3: Pinned prompt headers, MCP always-load tools, plugin agents.json, and sandbox protection for user application data
item.description: Adds pinned prompt headers during transcript scrolling, support for MCP servers to mark tools as always loaded, root-level agents.json support for plugins, and enhanced sandbox protection blocking reads to application data directories by default, alongside fixes for expired authentication and Jujutsu pager handling.

item.title: CLI 1.3.2: Interactive plugin marketplace manager, authoring capabilities, and /diff Commit Tree navigation
item.description: Introduces /plugin, an interactive manager for the official Antigravity plugin marketplace, alongside expanded plugin authoring options, permission controls in /plan mode, CPU efficiency improvements during heavy shell output, and navigation fixes for the /diff Commit Tree.

item.title: Hub 2.22.0: Sidebar drag-and-drop, UI Extensions, and localized conversation timestamps
item.description: Now you can drag-and-drop conversations to organize threads across the sidebar and conversation timestamps now use localized month names. This release also supports UI extensions that Antigravity shows in the side pane next to a conversation.

item.title: CLI 1.3.1: Enhanced /diff navigation and position indicators, Windows plugin lifecycle management, and subagent and task status fixes
item.description: Enhances/difffile view navigation with preserved cursor positions, cross-filen/Nchange traversal, and achange A/B · file X/Yheader indicator, while fixing/rewindon compacted messages, Windows/pluginMCP server lifecycle handling, relative paths in Markdown custom agents, subagent error states, and background task tracking.

item.title: Hub 2.21.1: Advanced Search, Automations, and grouped agent actions
item.description: Use ⌘+K (or CTRL+K on Windows) to search conversations based on their contents. The Scheduled Tasks tab is now called Automations, where you can run on-demand or scheduled automations or set up with the agent's help. Antigravity now also groups the agent's file edits, terminal commands, and file reads into one collapsible row.

item.title: CLI 1.3.0: Medium default verbosity, Vim-style j/k line navigation in /diff, and smooth trackpad scrolling
item.description: Updates the defaultVerbositysetting tomediumto group related tool calls and thoughts into concise summaries, alignsjandkin the/difffile view with standard line-by-line cursor movement, smooths trackpad and mouse-wheel scrolling over SSH andtmux, and fixes special-character and Windows drive path handling.

item.title: SDK 0.1.21: Experimental API isolation with @beta namespaces, declarative subagent skills configuration, and bulk hook registration
item.description: This release introduces experimental API isolation using the@betadecorator and.betanamespaces, granular skills configuration for subagents, and bulk hook registration during agent initialization. It also expands typing support for tool context annotations, refinesUsageMetadataarithmetic operations, and resolves an issue where tool calls with empty string IDs were unintentionally deduplicated.

item.title: Visual Studio 1.0.261005.0: Automatic environment diagnostics in feedback submissions and chat feedback dialog fix
item.description: Introduces automatic Visual Studio environment diagnostics in feedback submissions and resolves an issue opening the feedback dialog from the chat interface.

item.title: VS Code 1.7.0: Native Windows desktop notifications, undo/redo and side-by-side actions for diff reviews, Cloud Workstations authentication, and inline diff stability fixes
item.description: Introduces native Windows desktop notifications when unfocused, undo/redo and side-by-side tab actions for diff reviews, interactive authentication in Cloud Workstations and Cloud Shell, and stability fixes for inline diff reviews and language server installation.

item.title: CLI 1.2.17: Dismissible announcement cards, non-admin Windows command sandboxing, and Markdown table alignment fixes
item.description: Introduces dismissible announcement cards above the prompt for model launches and service notices, improves the Windows command sandbox to run without administrator rights with out-of-the-box support for Python, Git, andnpm, and fixes Markdown table alignment with emoji and.tiffimage MIME handling.

item.title: CLI 1.2.16: Quick config value cycling, altscreen resize performance, built-in image-generator subagent, and selection improvements
item.description: Adds left/right arrow shortcuts to cycle settings in/config, improves altscreen resize performance and mouse text selection across the conversation and artifact viewers, delegates image creation to a built-inimage-generatorsubagent, refinesgocommand allow-listing andSend Immediatelymessage queueing, and resolves background process crashes and subdirectory manifest loading.

item.title: CLI 1.2.15: Native Android Termux binaries, lower-memory streaming redraws, and SSH and quota fixes
item.description: Adds prebuilt native Android binaries for Termux, reduces memory allocations during typing and streaming redraws, displays/usagequota reset times in the local time zone, scopesrepocommand allow-listing to subcommands, and fixes terminal resize freezes, exhausted AI credit retries, and SSH terminal image probing.

item.title: CLI 1.2.14: Queued messages configuration, systemd-free remote-control, faster conversation loading, and cursor and file handling fixes
item.description: Adds a configurable Queued Messages option in/config, supports runningremote-controlon Linux systems without systemd, accelerates resuming long conversation transcripts, factors attachments into automatic thread titles, hardens--json-schemavalidation, and fixes unicode cursor drift, special file hangs, and corrupted transcript step recovery.

item.title: Hub 2.19.1: Message subagents directly, export Markdown as PDF, and conversation-only undo
item.description: You can now send messages straight to a subagent from the message box, export rendered Markdown as a PDF, and revert only the conversation when you undo. You can also reopen the window from the tray icon on Windows and Linux. This release includes 5 improvements and 5 fixes.

item.title: Xcode 1.3.0: Enterprise LLM gateway routing, real-time token usage streaming, and third-party model support for Xcode, JetBrains, and Zed
item.description: Introduces enterprise custom LLM gateway routing with proxy and custom CA support, real-time context window usage streaming, and third-party model availability across Xcode, JetBrains IDEs, and Zed.

item.title: Zed 1.3.0: Enterprise LLM gateway routing, real-time token usage streaming, and third-party model support for Xcode, JetBrains, and Zed
item.description: Introduces enterprise custom LLM gateway routing with proxy and custom CA support, real-time context window usage streaming, and third-party model availability across Xcode, JetBrains IDEs, and Zed.

item.title: JetBrains 1.3.0: Enterprise LLM gateway routing, real-time token usage streaming, and third-party model support for Xcode, JetBrains, and Zed
item.description: Introduces enterprise custom LLM gateway routing with proxy and custom CA support, real-time context window usage streaming, and third-party model availability across Xcode, JetBrains IDEs, and Zed.

item.title: Visual Studio 1.0.260928.0: Improved inline diff accuracy and cross-platform line-ending normalization
item.description: Introduces improved inline diff accuracy and line-change calculations using Visual Studio's native hierarchical diff engine.

item.title: VS Code 1.6.0: Terminal context integration (@terminal), native notifications, auto-accept inline diffs on chat send, and faster startup
item.description: Introduces@terminalcontext integration to reference active terminals and command output in chat, adds in-editor and native Linux desktop notifications when the agent finishes or needs input, enables auto-accepting pending background inline diffs on chat send, and delivers faster extension startup, resilient binary downloads, and comprehensive inline diff lifecycle fixes.

item.title: CLI 1.2.13: Dynamic retry delays for rate limits, rendering performance optimizations, and narrow terminal text wrapping
item.description: Adopts server-requested retry delays for API rate limits while halting early on extended caps, optimizes conversation redraw rendering efficiency to reduce CPU and memory churn, clarifies artifact viewer mode toggle hints, and fixes text clipping on narrow terminals.

item.title: Hub 2.18.1: Manage & Install plugins in AGY
item.description: This release introduces a Customizations tab and marketplace for discovering and installing plugins and includes overall improvements to the sidebar and chat experience.

item.title: CLI 1.2.12: Smooth full-screen scrolling, fast quota exhaustion handling, and replay and terminal fixes
item.description: Coalesces bursts of scroll events to reduce latency in full-screen views, terminates exhausted Gemini API key sessions immediately without wasteful retries, speeds up long conversation replays in lower verbosities, prevents corrupt terminal titles inside screen/tmux/Zellij multiplexers, and fixes Vim mode multibyte character navigation and undo history.

item.title: CLI 1.2.11: Model reasoning effort level controls, unconfigured plugin handling, and terminal rendering and selection fixes
item.description: Introduces reasoning effort level controls selectable with--effortor/effort, adjusts unconfigured plugin loading behavior, restores ASCII fallbacks for Mermaid diagrams and LaTeX in WezTerm and VS Code terminals, improves artifact viewer copy interactions, and fixes project custom agent discovery across workspaces and headless runs.

item.title: CLI 1.2.10: Medium verbosity mode, artifact viewer background rendering, sandbox improvements, and error handling fixes
item.description: Introduces medium verbosity mode to group related tool calls into concise summaries, pre-renders Mermaid diagrams and LaTeX in the artifact viewer for Kitty terminals, enhances terminal sandbox behavior and directory configuration scanning, and fixes headless run exit codes and subagent worktree artifact handling.

item.title: Xcode 1.2.1: Intel macOS binary support, Gemini 3.8 Flash models, client gateway authentication, and per-session tool filtering
item.description: Introduces Intel macOS (darwin-x86_64) release binaries, Gemini 3.8 Flash model options, clientgatewayauthentication, and per-session built-in tool filtering.

item.title: Zed 1.2.1: Intel macOS binary support, Gemini 3.8 Flash models, client gateway authentication, and per-session tool filtering
item.description: Introduces Intel macOS (darwin-x86_64) release binaries, Gemini 3.8 Flash model options, clientgatewayauthentication, and per-session built-in tool filtering.

item.title: JetBrains 1.2.1: Intel macOS binary support, Gemini 3.8 Flash models, client gateway authentication, and per-session tool filtering
item.description: Introduces Intel macOS (darwin-x86_64) release binaries, Gemini 3.8 Flash model options, clientgatewayauthentication, and per-session built-in tool filtering.

item.title: VS Code 1.5.0: Faster startup binary verification, refreshed activity bar and marketplace icons, and inline diff save and history review fixes
item.description: Introduces faster startup binary verification using cached file metadata, refreshes the Antigravity activity bar and marketplace icons, and fixes inline diff save and tab-close behavior, historical turn diff reviews, and multi-repository Git prompts.

item.title: CLI 1.2.9: Direct subagent messaging syntax, Vim numeric count multipliers, headless lifecycle handling, and concurrency fixes
item.description: Introduces direct@<subagent> <message>prompt syntax with interactive autocomplete, adds Vim count multipliers across Normal and Visual modes, enhances headless execution lifecycle and task timeout handling, and fixes file-lock concurrency issues in conversation history databases along with streaming response stability fixes.

item.title: CLI 1.2.8: Proportional context compaction budgets, full-window sizing, custom model media support, and leak fixes
item.description: Improves context compaction by spreading user-request budgets proportionally across all prompts and sizing truncation ceilings from the model's full context window, enables default PDF and audio support for custom models, routesCtrl+Geditor launches to a real terminal stdout, caps voice dictation recordings to avoid deadline failures, and resolves resource and memory leaks across conversations and background pollers.

item.title: Hub 2.16.0: Windows Subsystem for Linux, Office attachments, and live subagent cards
item.description: Connect to a Windows Subsystem for Linux distribution from Application Settings, and drop Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files straight into a prompt. Subagents now appear as live cards you can follow and stop while they work. This release also adds right-click copy and save for images.

item.title: Hub 2.17.0: Plan before you build
item.description: Type/planand the agent drafts a plan you can read and edit before it writes any code. The Agent setting that governs this is now called Plan Review Policy, and you can set it to review every plan, review only when the agent judges it worthwhile, or skip review entirely.

item.title: SDK 0.1.18: Local model support with LiteRT and LocalOpenAI, standardized evaluation presets, and custom subagent models
item.description: This release announces official Antigravity SDK local model support with first-classLiteRTAgentConfigandLocalOpenAIAgentConfigconfigurations, introduces a standardized evaluation preset (AgentConfig.eval()) for core coding evaluations, enables custom subagent model overrides, turns on thescheduletool by default across standard tool groups, and pairs background task management with command execution.

item.title: Visual Studio 1.0.260921.0: Fixes for docked tool window tab visibility and chat keyboard focus
item.description: Introduces fixes for docked tool window tab-switching visibility and keyboard focus in the chat interface.

item.title: CLI 1.2.7: Inline Kitty graphics for math and Mermaid diagrams, interactive ask_question navigation, dedicated rule token budgets, and 30s retry backoff
item.description: Introduces inline Kitty graphics rendering for LaTeX math and Mermaid diagrams in the artifact detail viewer with ASCII fallback and horizontal panning, interactive question navigation with write-in previews inask_question, dedicated 20,000-token rule budgets to prevent customization eviction, and caps model retry backoff at 30 seconds, alongside plugin lifecycle hardening, Bubble Tea v2.0.9 upgrades, and headless background task logging.

item.title: Hub 2.15.1: Windows sandbox support
item.description: This release introduces file and network sandboxing on Windows.

item.title: CLI 1.2.6: Session-scoped Remote Control, unlimited headless run timeouts, structured error reporting, and artifact text selection
item.description: Introduces session-scoped Remote Control using--remote-controland/remote-control, lifts the default 5-minute timeout on headless runs, adds structuredAGY_ERRORoutput on stderr, improves word-wise navigation in the prompt editor, and fixes Remote Control workspace permission inheritance, oversized file edit storage limits, full-screen artifact text selection, queued/modelswitching, and/rewindsnapshot resolution.

item.title: Hub 2.15.0: Custom agent controls and keyboard navigation
item.description: Custom agents can now switch off the default prompts and tools, and the agent you pick sticks with you after a reload. This release also adds Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, and Escape for moving around a conversation, speeds up switching conversations in the sidebar, and fixes a batch of settings and conversation state issues.

item.title: Visual Studio 1.0.260914.2: Unsaved @file context support, diff persistence and non-UTF-8 encoding fixes, and tool window stability
item.description: Introduces@filecontext support for unsaved editor buffers and resolves issues with inline diff persistence, non-UTF-8 file encoding in diffs, external browser links, and tool window responsiveness.

item.title: VS Code 1.4.0: In-IDE feedback reporting with diagnostic logs, resilient auto-updates with offline fallback, and Windows file-lock recovery
item.description: Introduces in-editor feedback and diagnostic log reporting, resilient backend auto-updates with fast-path offline startup, Windows binary upgrade file-lock recovery, and faster secondary panel loading.

item.title: CLI 1.2.5: Subagent roster prompt injection, background task names, credential invalidation handling, and thinking frame freeze fixes
item.description: Introduces automatic subagent roster and instruction injection for custom Markdown agents, preserves explicit background task names across notifications and lists, cleanly clears invalidated auth credentials, and fixes interrupted command exit codes, remote cancellation indicators, artifact viewer window resizing, and frozen thinking frames.

item.title: Xcode 1.2.0: Gemini Enterprise source citations, grounded web search summaries, and license sign-in reliability fixes
item.description: Introduces source citation blocks and groundedsearch_websummaries on Gemini Enterprise, while streamlining license selection and sign-in error recovery.

item.title: Zed 1.2.0: Gemini Enterprise source citations, grounded web search summaries, and license sign-in reliability fixes
item.description: Introduces source citation blocks and groundedsearch_websummaries on Gemini Enterprise, while streamlining license selection and sign-in error recovery.

item.title: JetBrains 1.2.0: Gemini Enterprise source citations, grounded web search summaries, and license sign-in reliability fixes
item.description: Introduces source citation blocks and groundedsearch_websummaries on Gemini Enterprise, while streamlining license selection and sign-in error recovery.

item.title: CLI 1.2.4: Live skill reloading, interactive model search, mid-session thought signature fixes, and self-correcting tool validation
item.description: Adds/skills reloadfor live skill discovery, introduces fuzzy search and autocomplete for/model, improves OAuth scope error guidance, and resolves mid-conversation model switching errors with Gemini thinking models,search_websummarization failures, tool schema validation recovery, and daemon conversation resumption.

item.title: CLI 1.2.3: Copy support for side questions, native backend tool-choice constraints, and subagent MCP inheritance
item.description: Introduces/copy btwto copy side-question responses directly to the clipboard, translates tool-choice constraints to native backend function calling, and fixes plugin hook discovery, subagent MCP server inheritance, relative config path resolution, and premature proactive feedback prompts.

item.title: Hub 2.14.0: New Permissions System & Terminal and Git version control for Enterprise
item.description: Enterprise and Business accounts can now use the integrated terminal and Git version control in the sidebar. This release also cuts memory use in long conversations and fixes a range of stability and accessibility issues.

item.title: SDK 0.1.17: Conversation compaction controls, forward-looking budget scopes, and tool output token truncation
item.description: This release introduces first-class conversation compaction controls usingCompactionConfig, delta and forward-looking budget scopes for session resumption, tool output token truncation limits, and expanded arithmetic operations onUsageMetadata. It also delivers OS-level terminal sandboxing examples and automated tool wrapper reflection preservation.

item.title: CLI 1.2.2: Plugin MCP namespacing, conversation memory leak fixes, oversized file guardrails, and unsandboxed rule migration warnings
item.description: Enhances startup migration diagnostics for unsandboxed permission rules, speeds up/resumewith stale caches, automatically namespaces plugin MCP servers to avoid collision, resolves step-cache goroutine leaks, and fixes critical issues with Gemini API thinking block retention, oversized binary file loading, artifact reviews, and database cleanup.

item.title: CLI 1.2.1: Custom agent component exclusions, resilient model API retry handling, and conversation continuation fixes
item.description: IntroducesexcludeDefaultComponentsfor custom agent Markdown definitions, adds automated exponential backoff retries for transient model API errors, improves MCP open object schema validation, and fixes issues with--continueworkspace resolution, inline terminal screen flashes, Remote Control auth display, and sandbox status indicators.

item.title: Visual Studio 1.0.260907.0: Background service reliability and diagnostic reporting stability improvements
item.description: Introduces background service reliability and diagnostic reporting stability improvements.

item.title: VS Code 1.3.0: OS root CA certificate and proxy inheritance, refreshed initialization UI, faster startup and Settings load, and Git index and focus fixes
item.description: Introduces automatic host OS root CA certificate and proxy inheritance for enterprise networks, a refreshed initialization screen, faster startup and Settings loading, and fixes for Git index stability and editor focus.

item.title: CLI 1.2.0: Background service registration with remote-control, expanded half-page scrolling, and content safety reporting
item.description: Introduces remote-control service manager subcommands to run the CLI as a persistent background daemon, broadens half-page scrolling support and keybindings, and resolves issues with content filter handling, scratch directory watchers, plugin MCP initialization, schema validation, and conversation resumption.

item.title: CLI 1.1.28: Model API retry resilience, headless print optimizations, and detailed tool approval prompts
item.description: Improves resilience to transient model API errors with extended exponential backoff, accelerates startup and sign-in by reading cached credentials, streamlines headless execution and error reporting, enhances tool approval prompts with contextual action descriptions and reasons, and fixes issues across plugin reinstalls, plugin MCP working directories, subagent lifecycle states, and command memory leaks.

item.title: Hub 2.13.0: Introducing new Documents section and several UX enhancements for organization and control
item.description: External files such as Google Drive links, PDFs, and Office documents now have their own Documents section in the sidebar. This release also adds a virtualized viewer for large code and data artifacts, an option to hide whitespace-only changes in diffs, and clearer warnings when a configuration file fails to parse.

item.title: VS Code 1.2.1: Fixes a webview message serialization conflict affecting third-party extensions such as GitLens
item.description: Introduces a patch fix resolving a webview message serialization conflict with third-party extensions such as GitLens.

item.title: CLI 1.1.27: Mid-conversation model execution, custom agent subagent dependencies, and MCP parameter validation fixes
item.description: Introduces /model <name> <prompt> for running one-off prompts with alternative models, adds conversation_title metadata to status line scripts, adds subagent dependency declarations in custom agent Markdown frontmatter, and delivers fixes for MCP argument schema validation, headless permission handling, Vim normal mode shortcuts, and cross-conversation artifact access prompts.

item.title: CLI 1.1.26: Artifact viewer half-page scrolling, workspace picker grouping setting, and SQLite WAL flushing
item.description: Adds half-page scrolling (Ctrl+D / Ctrl+U) to the artifact viewer, adds the pickerGrouping configuration setting for /resume, improves Mermaid flowchart ASCII rendering, updates unselected model reasoning defaults to medium, and resolves issues with worktree cleanup, SQLite WAL checkpointing on exit, and subagent approval prompts.

item.title: Xcode 1.1.2: Automatic enterprise model fallback and compatibility fixes for Xcode MCP tool payloads and Gemini API key authentication
item.description: Introduces automatic session model fallback when enterprise-allowed models change and resolves MCP tool argument and Gemini API key authentication issues in Xcode.

item.title: Zed 1.1.2: Automatic enterprise model fallback and compatibility fixes for Xcode MCP tool payloads and Gemini API key authentication
item.description: Introduces automatic session model fallback when enterprise-allowed models change and resolves MCP tool argument and Gemini API key authentication issues in Xcode.

item.title: JetBrains 1.1.2: Automatic enterprise model fallback and compatibility fixes for Xcode MCP tool payloads and Gemini API key authentication
item.description: Introduces automatic session model fallback when enterprise-allowed models change and resolves MCP tool argument and Gemini API key authentication issues in Xcode.

item.title: Visual Studio 1.0.260901.0: Improved Visual Studio Marketplace extension categories and search discoverability
item.description: Introduces updated Visual Studio Marketplace extension categories and search tags to improve extension discoverability alongside internal reliability updates.

item.title: VS Code 1.2.0: Status bar settings shortcut, autoOpenFiles and serverPort settings, browser clipboard and CORS fixes, and inline diff lifecycle improvements
item.description: Introduces a status bar shortcut for Settings, new configuration options for auto-opening edited files and pinning the server port, and fixes for browser-based VS Code environments, inline diff lifecycles, and duplicate tabs.

item.title: CLI 1.1.25: Workspace-grouped resume view, Gemini 3.8 Flash support, and Markdown agent ambient customization inheritance
item.description: Adds an opt-in workspace-grouped view to the/resumepicker withCtrl+Ftoggling, adds Gemini 3.8 Flash to the model catalog forGEMINI_API_KEYusers, updates Markdown-defined custom agents to inherit ambient skills, rules, and subagents by default, and delivers fixes for long MCP OAuth authorization codes, Windows skill path separators,/boostworker tools, and runtime nil pointer crashes.

item.title: Hub 2.12.2: Gemini 3.8 Flash using ADC in AGY Enterprise
item.description: Enterprise users can now access Google's flagship Gemini 3.8 Flash reasoning models using ADC.

item.title: Xcode 1.1.1: Enterprise terminal command sandboxing, Gemini Enterprise license picker refinements, and regional license routing fixes
item.description: Introduces enterprise terminal command sandboxing and refines the Gemini Enterprise license picker and regional endpoint routing.

item.title: Zed 1.1.1: Enterprise terminal command sandboxing, Gemini Enterprise license picker refinements, and regional license routing fixes
item.description: Introduces enterprise terminal command sandboxing and refines the Gemini Enterprise license picker and regional endpoint routing.

item.title: JetBrains 1.1.1: Enterprise terminal command sandboxing, Gemini Enterprise license picker refinements, and regional license routing fixes
item.description: Introduces enterprise terminal command sandboxing and refines the Gemini Enterprise license picker and regional endpoint routing.

item.title: CLI 1.1.24: MCP panel navigation improvements, multi-line comment support in mcp_config.json, and headless stream cleanup
item.description: Improves/mcppanel arrow key navigation and action cycling, adds support for comments and trailing commas inmcp_config.json, ensures headless CLI streams close cleanly on exit, and delivers fixes for duplicate agent listings, deleted working directory startup, and/btwside questions with active goals.

item.title: Hub 2.12.0: Quoting, /boost, and improved Settings
item.description: You can now highlight part of a response and quote it as context for a follow-up prompt, and paid users get the new/boostcommand for a deeper multi-agent reasoning pass. This release also brings UX improvements across settings, the chat panel, and sidebar navigation.

item.title: Model launch: Gemini 3.8 Flash
item.description: Gemini 3.8 Flash builds on 3.7 Flash as an everyday model for agentic development, with thinking levels that trade reasoning depth for lower latency.

item.title: CLI 1.1.23: Model autocompletion improvements, subagent streaming optimizations, and MCP tool resolution fixes
item.description: Improves/model <name>autocompletion with Tab acceptance, reduces subagent streaming telemetry overhead, and delivers stability fixes for prompt hooks, MCP tools in subagents, tool call IDs in request history, and OAuth token refreshes.

item.title: SDK 0.1.16: Default Gemini 3.8 Flash model upgrade, lightweight agent configuration, and Vertex AI Express mode
item.description: The 0.1.16 release updates the default model for new agents togemini-3.8-flashfor enhanced reasoning capabilities, introduces a.lightweight()method on agent configs for small and local models, adds Vertex AI Express mode with API keys, and expands tool runner support for callable classes and dataclass functors.

item.title: Xcode 1.1.0: Interactive Gemini Enterprise license picker and self-assignment during OAuth sign-in, plus Agent Client Protocol 0.12.1 support
item.description: Introduces an interactive browser-based Gemini Enterprise license picker with self-assignment support during OAuth sign-in and updates the server to Agent Client Protocol (acp)0.12.1.

item.title: Zed 1.1.0: Interactive Gemini Enterprise license picker and self-assignment during OAuth sign-in, plus Agent Client Protocol 0.12.1 support
item.description: Introduces an interactive browser-based Gemini Enterprise license picker with self-assignment support during OAuth sign-in and updates the server to Agent Client Protocol (acp)0.12.1.

item.title: JetBrains 1.1.0: Interactive Gemini Enterprise license picker and self-assignment during OAuth sign-in, plus Agent Client Protocol 0.12.1 support
item.description: Introduces an interactive browser-based Gemini Enterprise license picker with self-assignment support during OAuth sign-in and updates the server to Agent Client Protocol (acp)0.12.1.

item.title: Visual Studio 1.0.260826.0: First-install tool window activation, active chat protection on solution switch, CLI download retries, and theme and docked window fixes
item.description: Introduces automatic first-install tool window activation, active chat protection when switching solutions, resilient CLI download retries, and fixes for theme synchronization and docked window rendering.

item.title: VS Code 1.1.0: Google Antigravity Marketplace branding, resilient CLI download retries, auto-jump diff hunk navigation, and theme and diff persistence fixes
item.description: Introduces Google Antigravity Marketplace branding, automatic CLI download retries with an interactive retry card, automatic navigation to the next diff hunk on accept or reject, and fixes for theme colors and diff persistence.

item.title: CLI 1.1.22: Model selection command arguments, reasoning effort autocompletion, transient retry handling, and UI performance fixes
item.description: Adds direct/model <name>switching with inline ghost text autocompletion, dynamic/efforthint completion, artifact filesystem event coalescing, and fixes for transient HTTP 502 retries, CPU redraw utilization, and Windows path resolution.

item.title: CLI 1.1.21: Voice dictation, embedded ripgrep code search, status line cost metrics, and UTF-8 encoding fixes
item.description: Adds/voicedictation withmic-serveSSH forwarding, embedded ripgrep for consistent agent code search, custom status line cost tracking, granular script runner permission suggestions, and UTF-8 file editing and MCP error fixes.

item.title: Hub 2.11.0: Generative UI and UI improvements
item.description: Generative UI renders HTML artifacts inline in chat, with support for KaTeX math and Chart.js and Plotly charts. This release also adds side-by-side terminal splits, the Darcula theme, and@path/to/filereferences inside AGENTS.md and custom rule files.

item.title: SDK 0.1.15: Subagent-scoped custom tools, context compaction lifecycle hooks, and universal JSON schema normalization
item.description: The 0.1.15 release introduces subagent-exclusive tool scoping to reduce context overhead, adds anon_compactionlifecycle hook for observing context checkpointing, expands platform compatibility with Alpine Linux musl wheels, resolves workspace path normalization and custom Vertex endpoint routing, and adds universal JSON Schema normalization for custom Python tools when targeting local OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoints.

item.title: CLI 1.1.20: Skill icon branding, empty directory indexing in @-completion, and headless exit code fixes
item.description: Adds skill icon branding with Unicode alignment in catalogs and slash commands, indexes empty directories in@path completion, auto-approves workspace-scoped read access in review mode, and fixes headless print mode error handling.

item.title: Hub 2.10.0: Embedded Terminals, Git Version Control, and Audio Attachments
item.description: An embedded terminal and Git-native version control now live directly in the sidebar. This release also adds audio file attachments, interactive image commenting, richer previews for MCP tool execution, and core performance work.

item.title: CLI 1.1.18: Project name flags, customizable picker keybindings, typo-tolerant @-completion, and audio attachments
item.description: Adds support for passing project names to--project, customizable keybindings for conversation management, typo-tolerant@file completion, and standard audio attachments alongside reliability and terminal layout fixes.

item.title: CLI 1.1.19: Dynamic remote control port allocation, banner logo toggles, and rendering flags
item.description: Introduces automatic free port selection for--remote-control, environment controls to suppress logo art for narrow terminals and screen readers, and renderer bypass options.

item.title: SDK 0.1.14: Workspace path resolution against current working directory, compaction event deduplication, and Vertex auth overrides
item.description: Resolves relative workspace paths against the current working directory, prevents duplicate compaction hook dispatches and compaction index inflation, and adds support for Vertex AI gateway authentication overrides.

item.title: Xcode 1.0.0: Initial Agent Client Protocol (ACP) server release with multi-method authentication, model and mode selectors, MCP tool streaming, and Gemini Enterprise policy controls
item.description: Introduces the Google Antigravity Agent Client Protocol (ACP) server (antigravity-acp) for Xcode, JetBrains IDEs, Zed, and custom ACP clients, with multi-method authentication, configurable model and session mode selectors, rich tool and permission streaming, and Gemini Enterprise administrator policy controls.

item.title: Zed 1.0.0: Initial Agent Client Protocol (ACP) server release with multi-method authentication, model and mode selectors, MCP tool streaming, and Gemini Enterprise policy controls
item.description: Introduces the Google Antigravity Agent Client Protocol (ACP) server (antigravity-acp) for Xcode, JetBrains IDEs, Zed, and custom ACP clients, with multi-method authentication, configurable model and session mode selectors, rich tool and permission streaming, and Gemini Enterprise administrator policy controls.

item.title: JetBrains 1.0.0: Initial Agent Client Protocol (ACP) server release with multi-method authentication, model and mode selectors, MCP tool streaming, and Gemini Enterprise policy controls
item.description: Introduces the Google Antigravity Agent Client Protocol (ACP) server (antigravity-acp) for Xcode, JetBrains IDEs, Zed, and custom ACP clients, with multi-method authentication, configurable model and session mode selectors, rich tool and permission streaming, and Gemini Enterprise administrator policy controls.

item.title: CLI 1.1.16: CLI mcp management commands, debounced @ path completion, and MCP resource handling fixes
item.description: mcpmanagement subcommands (add,remove,list,enable,disable) formcp_config.json, debounced@file path completion powered by bundledripgrep, Gemini API key reasoning effort adjustment for Gemini Flash models, and comprehensive fixes for binary MCP resource offloading, Workforce Identity Federation token refresh,/mcpconfiguration preservation, Kitty keyboard protocol handling,/btwwith custom agents, and finished task status tracking.

item.title: CLI 1.1.17: Consolidated agent execution harness and media attachment fixes
item.description: Consolidated agent execution harness for consistent tool, hook, and prompt behavior, alongside fixes for slash command visibility, Vim insert mode task navigation, and Ogg audio/video attachment MIME types.

item.title: Hub 2.9.1: Remote Control, faster project switching, and more
item.description: This update introduces Remote Control to drive and monitor agent sessions on your local device from any browser, alongside core performance gains, improved sidebar navigation, and cleaner error recovery.

item.title: CLI 1.1.15: Stream-JSON input mode, markdown agent explicit rules, and startup credential fixes
item.description: Stream-JSON print input mode for persistent session drivers, direct rule file configuration in markdown agent frontmatter, plugin rule support usingrules.json, current tool call hints on the spinner, and fixes for allocator preloading on Cloud TPU VMs, keyring credential restoration, terminal scrolling and unicode display in the model picker, and artifact subdirectories.

item.title: SDK 0.1.13: Pre-tool argument modification, synchronous lifecycle hooks, RunCommandConfig timeouts, and step correlation IDs
item.description: The 0.1.13 release introduces pre-tool argument modification capabilities in lifecycle hooks, adds native support for synchronous hook functions, and establishes structured command execution configuration with configurable execution timeouts. It also improves tool execution observability with step correlation IDs and enhances connection resilience during client disconnects.

item.title: Visual Studio 1.0.260818.0: Initial release of Antigravity for Visual Studio with agentic chat, side-by-side diff previews, interactive planning artifacts, and chorded keyboard shortcuts
item.description: Introduces the initial release of the Google Antigravity extension for Visual Studio, featuring an integrated AI agent chat tool window, native side-by-side diff previews with batch edit controls, interactive planning artifact tabs, automatic CLI management, and full Visual Studio theme and shortcut integration.

item.title: VS Code 1.0.0: Initial 1.0.0 release of Antigravity for VS Code with agentic chat, in-editor inline diffs, interactive plan review, and Remote-SSH support
item.description: Introduces the 1.0.0 release of Antigravity for VS Code, bringing an agentic AI coding assistant with sidebar chat, in-editor inline diff review, interactive implementation plan artifacts, and Remote-SSH workspace support.

item.title: CLI 1.1.14: Enterprise sign-in fast path, MCP OAuth metadata documents, /context scrolling, and markdown agent customizations
item.description: Fast return path for enterprise sign-in, support for OAuth client ID metadata documents in MCP servers, terminal-sized scrollable/contextand/usagepanels, unifiedinheritCustomizationsconfiguration for markdown agents, read-only permissions outside the workspace, and fixes for language server crashes, hyperlink rendering, artifact approval tracking, MCP error isolation, and bracketed paste.

item.title: CLI 1.1.13: GEMINI_API_KEY authentication, custom agent task management, embedded ripgrep caching, and conversation database fixes
item.description: DirectGEMINI_API_KEYauthentication support,/codesearchfallback resilience, cached artifact list scrolling,manage_taskaccess for custom declarative agents, embedded ripgrep caching with SHA-256 verification, and critical fixes for trajectory truncation, database growth, transcript race conditions, and subagent path validation.

item.title: IDE 2.5.5: Windows Media Attachments and Chat Responsiveness Improvements
item.description: Bug fixes addressing media attachment failures on Windows and improving message responsiveness when interacting with the agent.

item.title: SDK 0.1.12: Fix proto deserialization regression for ActionGenerateImage output paths
item.description: The 0.1.12 release fixes a client-side proto deserialization regression in image generation result handling.

item.title: Hub 2.8.1: Chat Responsiveness Improvements
item.description: Bug fixes addressing message responsiveness when interacting with the agent.

item.title: Model launch: Gemini 3.7 Flash
item.description: Gemini 3.7 Flash plans multi-step work and tool calls more carefully than 3.6 Flash, with gains in first-pass code accuracy and web development.

item.title: IDE 2.5.2: Queued Messages, File Attachments, and Performance Improvements
item.description: Support for queued messages, plain text, PDF, and markdown file attachments, model thinking level selector, and major conversation performance improvements.

item.title: Hub 2.8.0: Persistent Sidebar Folders, Crash Fixes, and UI Enhancements
item.description: Antigravity improves workspace organization by persisting your sidebar folder states. This release also ensures reliable file and artifact previews.

item.title: SDK 0.1.11: Default Gemini 3.7 Flash upgrade, session budget limits, Vertex AI Express Mode, and autonomous behavior modes
item.description: The 0.1.11 release updates the default model togemini-3.7-flash, introduces session-level budget enforcement and turn termination stop reasons, Vertex AI Express Mode authentication, and an autonomous agent behavior setting. It also expands tool hook metadata, resolves string annotation coercion for postponed evaluation, and improves MCP server and subagent stability.

item.title: CLI 1.1.12: Artifact heading outline, print-mode commands, artifact alerts/carousels, improved terminal hyperlinks, and extensive CLI fixes
item.description: Artifact outline viewer navigation, print-mode read-only slash commands, machine-readable output formodelsandagents, alert callout and carousel rendering in markdown artifacts, terminal hyperlink improvements, and fixes for headless--mode, startup diagnostics, subagent messaging, and quota reporting.

item.title: Hub 2.7.1: Reliability, Performance Gains, and User Experience Polish
item.description: Antigravity 2.7.1 introduces visual side-by-side previews for image diffs alongside comprehensive screen-reader and keyboard accessibility enhancements. This update also delivers key performance boosts, bug fixes, and UX refinements across chat interactions and project navigation.

item.title: CLI 1.1.11: Vim modal editing mode, Vim-aware submission, print-mode slash-command enhancements, and various CLI and permission fixes
item.description: Vim modal editing mode with Normal, Insert, Visual, and Visual Line modes, Vim-aware prompt submission, Vim editing in comment/diff views, print-mode slash-command and non-interactive enhancements, plugin configuration improvements, and fixes for command auto-approval, MCP servers, and autocomplete history.

item.title: Hub 2.6.0: Faster long conversations, more reliable hooks and subagents
item.description: Conversations with long histories now open faster, improved custom hooks and subagents behavior, and administrator policies for connected tool servers are applied correctly — plus a broad set of fixes across chat, comments and the file viewer.

item.title: SDK 0.1.10: Prioritized inference tiers, real-time token usage streaming, and context-aware hook decorators
item.description: The 0.1.10 release introduces support for Gemini Prioritized Inference service tiers, real-time token usage event streaming, stateful context-aware hook decorators, and explicit tool call correlation IDs across hook callbacks. It also standardizes default system instruction merging behavior, fixes WebSocket compaction events, and expands local Gemma model documentation.

item.title: CLI 1.1.10: Gemini Enterprise & WIF authentication, read-only .git sandbox rules, hook ordering improvements, and subagent and CLI fixes
item.description: Gemini Enterprise Business sign-in, Workforce Identity Federation (WIF) and Application Default Credentials (ADC) auth support, read-only.gitsandbox access, hook ordering improvements, and fixes for subagent tree termination,--model/--effortflag resolution, and multi-select spacebar toggling.

item.title: CLI 1.1.9: Slash-command expansion in print mode, non-blocking MCP startup, session-wide permission memory, system temp directory write grants, and hook and UI stability fixes
item.description: Added slash-command and skill expansion in print mode, non-blocking background MCP loading during interactive startup, session-scoped permission pattern recording, system temporary directory write grants, and stability fixes for stop/PostToolUse hooks, artifact viewer, and MCP authentication.

item.title: Hub 2.5.0: Enterprise sign-in: Gemini Enterprise accounts and Workforce Identity Federation
item.description: Added enterprise sign-in support for Gemini Enterprise user accounts (with admin controls) and Workforce Identity Federation using Advanced SSO.

item.title: CLI 1.1.8: Print mode structured output formats, custom JSON schema enforcement, copyOnSelect TUI setting, and compound-command permission improvements
item.description: Added structured output formats (json,stream-json) for print mode, support for custom JSON schema validation, enriched tool and subagent payloads,copyOnSelectconfiguration setting, and improved compound-command permission rules.

item.title: Hub 2.4.3: Preview tabs, MCP timeouts, file attachments, and performance fixes
item.description: Added preview tabs, attachment support for .json, .md, and .csv files, MCP timeouts, keyboard shortcuts, and various bug fixes and improvements.

item.title: SDK 0.1.9: Model-call retry/backoff configuration, LiteRT warm-up scaling, and tool execution error handling
item.description: Release 0.1.9 of the Google Antigravity Python SDK adds model-call retry/backoff configuration, improves tool registration for custom functions, adds missingBuiltinToolsexports, fixes user audio payload processing, and adds connectionDebugConfigsupport along withToolExecutionErrorhandling.

item.title: CLI 1.1.6: Markdown format custom agents, /copy index support, progressive /codesearch streaming, default temp directory access, and stability fixes
item.description: Added support for defining custom agents in Markdown format (agent.md), optional index argument for/copy, progressive streaming in/codesearch, default read access to system temporary directory, and resolved various TUI jitter, artifact viewer, and sandbox fixes.

item.title: CLI 1.1.7: Permission prompts for compound commands, and fixes for disabled plugins, MCP OAuth, and clipboard corruption
item.description: Improved permission prompts for compound shell commands, and fixed disabled plugins running hooks, MCP OAuth issuer validation, CJK clipboard copying on Windows, and/btwerror on startup.

item.title: SDK 0.1.8: Gemini 3.6 Flash default model, custom subagent instructions, and Pydantic argument coercion
item.description: Release 0.1.8 of the Google Antigravity Python SDK updates the default text model to Gemini 3.6 Flash, adds support for custom subagent instructions, and implements automatic Pydantic argument coercion for tool calls. It also brings defensive prompt sanitization, configurable tool retries, and comprehensive stability improvements for local agent execution.

item.title: CLI 1.1.5: Reasoning effort command, model slug pinning, subagent model configuration, and TUI stability improvements
item.description: Added/effortcommand and--effortflag for reasoning effort selection, stable model slugs, subagent model config, redesigned/modelpicker, scrollable/settingspanel, and various MCP and background task fixes.

item.title: Model launch: Gemini 3.6 Flash
item.description: Gemini 3.6 Flash improves coding, knowledge work, and multimodal tasks over 3.5 Flash while using up to 17% fewer tokens at a lower cost per token.

item.title: CLI 1.1.4: Slash command chaining, diff scrolling fixes, and headless policy enforcement
item.description: Added slash command stacking (chaining multiple commands in a single prompt), diff viewer scroll fixes, headless mode settings.json policy enforcement, and subagent declaration fixes.

item.title: CLI 1.1.3: Codesearch command, copy-on-select, and performance optimizations
item.description: New/codesearchcommand for regex workspace searches, copy-on-select, async skill discovery, and stability fixes.

item.title: Hub 2.3.1: Startup stability fix
item.description: Fixes a bug where an empty or malformed configuration file caused AGY to fail to load on startup.

item.title: SDK 0.1.7: Multi-threaded state handling, subprocess isolation, extra high thinking, and local model MCP
item.description: Release 0.1.7 of the Google Antigravity Python SDK expands end-user control over agent execution environments, strengthens concurrency safety for stateful tools, and introduces deeper reasoning capabilities. Key highlights include atomic multi-threaded state handling for tools and hooks, customizable subprocess environment variable isolation, support for an "extra_high" thinking severity level, and full Model Context Protocol (MCP) and subagent support across local model backends. This release also resolves interactive console prompt clobbering and improves socket discovery under containerized setups.

item.title: SDK 0.1.6: LiteRT model configurations, dynamic GCP environment hydration, and performance updates
item.description: This release expands local execution capabilities by broadening support for multimodal and web-connected tool workflows. Developers can now run Gemma models locally using LiteRT or integrate with local OpenAI-compatible APIs, natively return multimodal media from custom tools, and leverage a more robust, streamlined lifecycle hooks framework that is fully aligned with Model Context Protocol (MCP) workflows.
